sections.appearance: She has long, straight shoulder-length pink hair with bangs that cast shadows over her eyes. This lends itself to her trait: the appearance of a villainess or a demon queen. This is augmented by her haughty and pretentious smile and the horns that grow out of the rear of her head. Said horns are wine red, with symmetrical golden accents. She has striking amber eyes and small pupils. Halo ==== Aru's halo has a smaller circle slightly slanted to her left. A larger disfigured circle with dashed edges and stripes on both side surrounds the first circle. The second circle resembles a crescent moon. When looking at the inner and outer circle together, her halo somewhat resembles an eye. To the left and right sides of her halo, horizontal lines jut out sharply like spikes. It has a light peach color. Uniform ==== Aru wears a red Captain's coat with golden buckles, a long-sleeved collared white shirt, white gloves, a red ribbon around her neck, and an office skirt with gold-strapped high heels. Firearm ==== thumb|Wine Red • Admire|150px She uses a three-tone PSG-1 sniper rifle with a gold handguard, pistol grip, and stock. It has a black cheek rest and barrel. The rest of the receiver and most of the Hensoldt ZF riflescope is painted in maroon. Some short maroon belts wrap parts of the handguard. A gold rose decal can be seen on both sides of the receiver. The Handyman 68 insignia is stamped on right side of the cheek rest.

sections.personality: Rikuhachima Aru, the leader of Problem Solver 68 club at Gehenna Academy, is a second-year student with a knack for accepting various quests, legal or not. She puts on a cool, beauteous, and villainous facade but often breaks character, revealing her true caring and meticulous nature when teased or pressured. Behind her mischievous personality, Aru is a shy artist, striving for perfection. She has a thirst for knowledge and constantly seeks to expand her understanding of the criminal underworld, enhancing her problem-solving abilities. While not exceptionally intelligent, her unwavering determination and focus on her goals make up for it. Aru persists relentlessly until her tasks are thoroughly accomplished, though she can also be goofy and prone to panicking when things don't go according to plan. Her true goal is to make Problem Solver 68 a reputable criminal organization. She constantly tries to impress Sensei on many occasions, and frequently asks them to become a member of Problem Solver 68, despite their constant refusals. She indulges to her obsessions of portraying a delinquent and idolizes the image of a criminal without comprehending the true nature of such individuals.
